title: Evidence
description: Test results written by `aidd test` in CI. Each result is bound to one head commit.

path.description: The JUnit XML report the command named, as a path in the repository.

tests.description: How many test cases the report lists.

failed.description: How many of them hold a failure or an error.

skipped.description: How many of them were skipped.

failed_tests.description: The first failed test cases, as `classname.name`.

finding.description: Why the report could not be read: missing, not written by this run, too large, or not a JUnit report. The counts are then absent. The exit code stays the evidence.

report.description: What the command's JUnit XML report says about this run.

head_sha.description: The commit the green results ran on.

base_sha.description: The merge base the red results ran on.

run_id.description: The CI run or job id.

url.description: The CI run or job's web address.

runner.description: Which CI run produced this file.

source.description: Where the command came from: the config's `tests` or the Spec's tests.commands.

exit.description: The exit code, or null when the command did not start or timed out.

duration_seconds.description: How long it ran, in seconds.

log.description: Its output log, relative to the evidence folder.

exit.description: This attempt's exit code, or null when it did not start or timed out.

duration_seconds.description: How long this attempt ran, in seconds.

log.description: This attempt's output log, relative to the evidence folder.

report.description: This attempt's JUnit XML report, when the command names one.

attempts.description: Every attempt, oldest first, when a green run was retried (`retries`); the result's own fields are the last attempt's. A red run is never retried.

report.description: The command's JUnit XML report, when the command names one (`report`): the last attempt's.

flaky.description: True when a retry passed after a failure: the result counts green, and the flaky test is a finding to fix.

results.description: One entry per command and red_green run.

spec_phase.description: True when `aidd test` ran in the Spec phase: every changed path was the Spec or a file it freezes, and a Task had yet to change anything, so failing green results were expected.

partial.description: True when `aidd test --changed` ran only the commands the working-tree diff selects. A local convenience between steps: partial evidence never stands for the whole suite.

dirty_tree.description: True when the tests ran in a tree that holds what the head commit does not: uncommitted changes, untracked files no `.gitignore` in the repository ignores, or files git is told not to look at. None of its results is evidence for the head commit.

dirty_paths.description: The first of those paths, sorted, for the person who commits or stashes them.
